title: The Project Thing deck becomes the Thing page on gamecult.org: under the masthead, filling the screen, one copy scoped in the page; the applet URL redirects
first: Map: Eve docs/thing-campaign.md revision 4, section 'Fullscreen presentation': B12 (site layout), B13 (what Quartz does to raw HTML), 'The shape', 'Authority map delta'. Ruling thing:ruling:operator-deck-is-a-site-page, operator's words verbatim there. This spec assumes question thing-page-url = top-level (/Thing, GameCult/Thing.md); under blog-post the page file is GameCult/Blog/project-thing.md and isThingPage matches that slug.

Base: rebase onto the landing head of cut-deck-polish before starting. The deck's markup, styles and script are taken from site/quartz/static/applets/project-thing/index.html at that head, never from the artifact. Line numbers below are the committed HEAD ae0927f: <style> lines 9-252, <body> 254-529, <script> 530-679; they shift slightly after the polish cut.

Rules of the engine (B13): a <div>/<section> HTML block in Markdown ends at the first blank line, so the deck's markup must carry no blank line between <div class="thing-deck"> and its closing tag; <link> and <script src> elements in the body survive rehype-raw and run on load; CrawlLinks appends an external-link icon to every external <a>; Description indexes all article text, so styles and script are linked files, not inline.

Scoping (B13, 'The shape'): every selector in deck.css is prefixed .thing-deck; :root and body become .thing-deck; * becomes .thing-deck *; .rm rules become .thing-deck.rm ...; the script's root is document.querySelector('.thing-deck'). Site rules that reach in and must be redeclared inside the scope: a (weight, colour), strong, h1-h3 margins, p line-height, table/th/td padding and borders, ul list-style, .external-icon hidden.
There is no SPA router (enableSPA: false in site/quartz.config.ts): deck.js runs on each full load; nothing else is needed for scripts.

Deploy is push to main -> workflow 'Deploy Quartz' -> GitHub Pages at gamecult.org. Small commits on main; CI is the verifier. A local .\scripts\quartz\quartz.ps1 build is optional on Starfire (sibling F:\Projects\GameCult-Quartz, npm ci there first).

Precedents in the code: slug predicates in site/quartz.layout.ts (isGraphPage, isIntegratedDossierPage); slug-scoped chrome rules in site/quartz/styles/custom.scss (body[data-slug="Blog/the-sleeping-colossus-refuses-the-throne"], lines 1152-1180); the masthead tagline lifted from the page's first italic quote line (site/quartz/components/gamecult.ts stripTopTagline).

deletes.note: The 680-line applet becomes a 12-line redirect stub: doctype, charset, <title>Project Thing</title>, <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=/Thing">, <link rel="canonical" href="https://gamecult.org/Thing">, and a body with one link to /Thing. No deck markup, style or script remains in it (invariant old-names-resolve: the URL still answers 200).

The slug-scoped rule body[data-slug="Blog/project-thing"] .gamecult-embed-frame iframe { height: 85vh } (lines 1148-1150) is removed; the shared .gamecult-embed-frame rules stay for the cat post and Projects/CultPong.md.
The .gamecult-embed-frame div with its iframe and the 'open the deck directly' sentence are removed from the post body; frontmatter is unchanged.

keeps_moves: The deck's markup (between <body> and <script> at the polish cut's head) moves verbatim into GameCult/Thing.md inside one <div class="thing-deck"> wrapper, with only these edits: blank lines removed, and nothing else. Every section, exhibit, number and line of copy, including cut 1's two fact fixes and the polish cut's edits, is unchanged. Soul diffs the markup against the applet at the polish head and expects only the wrapper and the removed blank lines.

The deck's <style> content moves to site/quartz/static/thing/deck.css with the scoping edits in adds and no other change: same tokens, same weights, same keyframes, same media query at 760px, same reduced-motion rules.

The deck's <script> content moves to site/quartz/static/thing/deck.js with one edit: var root=document.documentElement becomes var root=document.querySelector('.thing-deck'). Everything else (hero intro, reveals, canvases, HUD, ticker, TPS) is unchanged.
GameCult/Blog/project-thing.md keeps its frontmatter (title, description, author, date, tags, socialDeck) and its H1 and first paragraph; it stays in the Blog index as the dated announcement.
The Eve card on GameCult/Projects/index.md keeps its Project Thing list item; only its href changes.
site/quartz/components/*, GameCult-Quartz (the engine), the shared .gamecult-embed-frame rules, the cat applet and the Graph viewer are not touched.
adds:
GameCult/Thing.md: frontmatter title 'Thing'; description, one sentence: the Project Thing board deck, a discussion document on renaming Eve to Thing; socialDeck 'Thing renders things.'; enableToc: false. Body, in this order and with no blank line inside the deck block: the tagline line *"Thing renders things."* (lifted into the masthead by stripTopTagline), a blank line, ,
... the deck's markup ...
, . No H1 (the deck's hero carries the h1).

site/quartz/static/thing/deck.css: the deck's stylesheet scoped. Prefix every selector with '.thing-deck ' (including those inside @media (max-width:760px)); the :root block becomes .thing-deck { ... } keeping color-scheme and every token; the body rule becomes .thing-deck { margin:0; color:var(--ink-2); font-family:var(--body); font-weight:300; font-size:18px; line-height:1.55 } with the background declaration dropped (the site body paints the same wash) and overflow-x:hidden dropped (the polish cut keeps every section inside the page); * becomes .thing-deck *; .rm X becomes .thing-deck.rm X; h1,h2,h3 / p / b,strong / table / td / th / tr.lit td / tr.strike td / [data-reveal...] are prefixed like any other selector. @keyframes names stay (no collision with custom.scss or base.scss).

site/quartz/static/thing/deck.css, reach-in guards appended at the end under the same scope: .thing-deck a { color: inherit; font-weight: inherit; text-decoration: inherit } unless the deck already styles the anchor (then that rule wins by its own specificity); .thing-deck strong, .thing-deck b { font-weight: 500 }; .thing-deck h1, .thing-deck h2, .thing-deck h3 { margin: 0 } (already present, kept); .thing-deck p { margin: 0; line-height: inherit }; .thing-deck table, .thing-deck th, .thing-deck td { the deck's own padding, border and background exactly as its table rules state, so base.scss lines 528-545 do not show through }; .thing-deck ul { list-style: the deck's value; padding and margin as the deck had }; .thing-deck .external-icon { display: none }.

site/quartz/static/thing/deck.js: the deck's script with var root=document.querySelector('.thing-deck'); tok() therefore reads the deck root's computed style, where the tokens now live, and reduced motion adds .rm to the deck root. Wrapped as it was (an IIFE); no module, no bundler.

site/quartz.layout.ts: const isThingPage = (page) => page.fileData.slug === "Thing"; isStandardContentPage also requires !isThingPage(page) (so Breadcrumbs, ArticleTitle, ContentMeta and Backlinks skip it); the right-sidebar GameCultOverviewSidebar condition adds && !isThingPage(page); the left TableOfContents renders nothing because enableToc is false. Both sidebars empty gives one column through the existing :has(:empty) grid rules.

site/quartz/styles/custom.scss, one slug-scoped block beside the other body[data-slug] blocks: body[data-slug="Thing"] { .page { max-width: none; padding: 0; } .page > #quartz-body .center > .page-header { max-width: 1680px; margin-inline: auto; padding: 0 1.2rem; } .page > #quartz-body .center > article { background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; padding: 0; } .page > #quartz-body .center > hr { display: none; } .page > #quartz-body .center > .page-footer { margin-top: 0; } }. The site Footer stays below the deck. Nothing in this block targets anything inside .thing-deck.
GameCult/Blog/project-thing.md body after the H1: the existing paragraph, then one sentence with a link: Open the Thing page. Nothing else.
GameCult/Projects/index.md, Eve card: the Project Thing list item's href becomes /Thing; its text is unchanged.
